workaround_steps: Configure WSA Advanced Settings > Graphics Architecture to dedicated GPU (DirectX 12) with at least 6 GB of allocated VRAM.
Set in-game graphics preset to 'Low' or 'Medium' with 30/45 FPS cap for thermal stability.
A third-party touch-to-key mapping utility or connected Xbox controller is recommended for full combat controls.
known_issues: Substantial virtualized shader compilation overhead on first game startup; high GPU utilization may throttle thin-and-light laptop chassis.
